title: How Many SAE Features Are Needed to Explain a Single Safety-Relevant Behavior?
original_idea: Using GPT-2 Small with SAELens, collect SAE feature activations across 100 examples each of two contrasting behavior categories. Compute the minimum set of features that perfectly classifies the two categories. Plot the distribution of set sizes.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong theory: if minimum description length is too large, SAE-based safety auditing is impractical. Directly quantifiable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pretrained SAEs available via SAELens. Requires basic feature selection (greedy or sklearn). Feasible for beginners with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-scoped: two categories, minimum feature set computation, distribution plot. Slightly open-ended in choosing behavior categories.
